agencyDescription.en: A small directory of verified companions in Hong Kong. Contact a manager on Telegram or WhatsApp.
agencyDescription.zhHantHK: 香港核實伴侶目錄。透過 Telegram 或 WhatsApp 聯絡客戶經理。

defaultSeoDescription.en: Browse companion profiles by district in Hong Kong. Message a manager directly.
defaultSeoDescription.zhHantHK: 按地區瀏覽香港伴侶檔案，直接聯絡客戶經理。

intro.en: Companions based in Hong Kong, listed by district. Contact is through the agency manager — not a booking form.
intro.zhHantHK: 駐香港的伴侶，按地區列出。聯絡方式為客戶經理，而非線上預訂。

body.en: Hong Kong is the first destination on this directory. Open a district or a profile, then message the manager on Telegram or WhatsApp.
body.zhHantHK: 香港是本目錄的第一個目的地。開啟地區或個人檔案後，透過 Telegram 或 WhatsApp 聯絡客戶經理。

intro.en: Profiles currently associated with Central. A profile URL does not change if she later moves district.
intro.zhHantHK: 目前與中環相關的檔案。即使之後改區，個人檔案網址也不會改變。

intro.en: Profiles currently associated with Wan Chai.
intro.zhHantHK: 目前與灣仔相關的檔案。

summary.en: Test profile for the Hong Kong catalog. Message the manager to enquire.
summary.zhHantHK: 香港目錄的測試檔案。查詢請聯絡客戶經理。

body.en: This is seed content so the country, district and profile routes can be opened before real profiles are added in Studio.
body.zhHantHK: 這是種子內容，讓國家、地區和個人檔案頁面在 Studio 加入真實檔案之前就能開啟。
